# OBS triggers

## Any OBS event (advanced)

Runs for any message OBS sends, so you can react to things Cuebot has no special trigger for. For advanced users.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Event type** | Only react to this kind of OBS message, like "InputActiveStateChanged". Leave empty to react to every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%eventType%` | The kind of OBS message |
| `%eventData%` | All the details OBS sent, as raw text |
| `%obsEvent.event%` | The kind of OBS message (same as eventType) |

<small>Type id: `obs.event`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to OBS. Handy for setting up your scene or sending yourself a "ready" message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |

<small>Type id: `obs.connected`</small>

## Current transition changed

Runs when you pick a different transition type in OBS (not when a transition plays).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Transition** | Only react when this transition is picked, like "Fade". Leave empty for any transition. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%transitionName%` | The transition that is now selected |

<small>Type id: `obs.transitionChanged`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to OBS, for example when you close OBS.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |

<small>Type id: `obs.disconnected`</small>

## Filter state changed

Runs when a filter (an effect on a source, like a color tweak) is switched on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Source** | Only react to this source (or scene), typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam". Leave empty for any. |
| **Filter** | Only react to this filter, typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Color Correction". Leave empty for any filter. |
| **State** | Pick Enabled to react when it turns on, Disabled when it turns off, or Any for both. Options: Any, Enabled, Disabled. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%sourceName%` | The source or scene the filter belongs to |
| `%filterName%` | The name of the filter |
| `%filterEnabled%` | True when the filter is now on |

<small>Type id: `obs.filterStateChanged`</small>

## Input mute changed

Runs when an audio source (like your microphone) is muted or unmuted in OBS.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Input** | Only react to this audio source, typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Mic/Aux". Leave empty for any. |
| **State** | Pick Muted to react when it is muted, Unmuted when it is unmuted, or Any for both. Options: Any, Muted, Unmuted. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%inputName%` | The name of the audio source |
| `%inputMuted%` | True when the source is now muted |

<small>Type id: `obs.inputMuteChanged`</small>

## Input volume changed

Runs when the volume of an audio source changes in OBS.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Input** | Only react to this audio source, typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Mic/Aux". Leave empty for any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%inputName%` | The name of the audio source |
| `%inputVolumeDb%` | The new volume in decibels (0 is full volume, lower numbers are quieter) |
| `%inputVolumeMul%` | The new volume as a multiplier (1 is full volume, 0 is silent) |

<small>Type id: `obs.inputVolumeChanged`</small>

## Plugin message (advanced)

Runs when an OBS plugin sends its own message through OBS. For plugin fans; most people never need it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Vendor name** | Only react to messages from this plugin, like "obs-browser". Leave empty for any plugin. |
| **Event type** | Only react to this kind of message from the plugin. Leave empty for any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%vendorName%` | The plugin that sent the message |
| `%vendorEventType%` | The kind of message |
| `%eventData%` | The extra details the plugin sent, as raw text |

<small>Type id: `obs.vendorEvent`</small>

## Scene changed

Runs when OBS switches to another scene on the live output. Great for changing lights or sending a message for certain scenes.

| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Scene** | Only react to this scene, typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Just Chatting". Leave empty for any scene. |

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%sceneName%` | The scene OBS switched to |
| `%previousScene%` | The scene OBS was on before |

<small>Type id: `obs.sceneChanged`</small>

## Source visibility changed

Runs when a source (like a camera or image) is shown or hidden in a scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them. |
| **Scene** | Only react to this scene, typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Just Chatting". Leave empty for any scene. |
| **Source** | Only react to this source, typed exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam". Leave empty for any source. |
| **State** | Pick Visible to react when it appears, Hidden when it disappears, or Any for both. Options: Any, Visible, Hidden. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsConnection%` | The name of the OBS connection this came from |
| `%sceneName%` | The scene the source is in |
| `%sourceName%` | The name of the source |
| `%visible%` | True when the source is now shown, false when hidden |

<small>Type id: `obs.sourceVisibilityChanged`</small>
